verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents M2M applications that issue API access credentials for programmatic access (workos-docs-32). AuthKit acts as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server for securing MCP servers (workos-docs-8, workos-docs-27), and RBAC permissions can be enforced through session JWTs. However, nothing explicitly shows per-credential scopes or least-privilege restriction for an agent, and the WorkOS MCP server gives an agent the same dashboard access as the user rather than a narrowed scope (workos-docs-9). Missing for 10: documented per-credential scope/permission restriction for agent or M2M credentials, least-privilege scoping for the WorkOS management API or MCP access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
